user.title: Connect to ACWD Portal
user.description:
Enter your ACWD portal credentials (portal.acwd.org).

Your credentials are stored securely in Home Assistant and used only to retrieve water usage data from your account.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to ACWD portal

init.title: Water rate
init.description: Price in USD per ACWD billing unit (748 gallons). The hourly cost statistic uses this rate. A new rate re-prices today's hours on the next update, and yesterday's hours when an update runs before noon or the integration starts. Older days keep the rate they were imported with. The cost excludes the bi-monthly meter service charge.
